sentiment.rationale: The document reports a strong backward-looking quarter (revenue beat, $11B Blackwell ramp), but forward guidance is materially concerning: gross margin is guided to a trough of 71% (down from 73.5%) with a back-loaded, unproven recovery path to mid-70s later in the fiscal year. Additionally, tariffs are explicitly described as 'a little bit of an unknown' and growth decelerates from 114% to ~65% YoY. The net forward signal is negative, warranting a score of -0.50.

summary.revenue: Q4 revenue of $39.3 billion, up 12% sequentially and 78% year on year. Full fiscal 2025 revenue of $130.5 billion, up 114% from the prior year.
summary.eps: Non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.89 vs $0.84 consensus (GAAP also $0.89). Full year non-GAAP EPS $2.99, up 130%.
summary.guidance: Q1 (next quarter) revenue guided to $43.0 billion ±2%, above consensus of $41.78 billion. Gross margin guided to 71% non-GAAP (±50bp), a trough. Management expects gross margin to return to mid-70s later this fiscal year.
summary.margin: Non-GAAP gross margin 73.5% in Q4, down sequentially. Q1 guided to 71% non-GAAP. Management expects improvement to mid-70s later this fiscal year.
key_risks: Gross margin trough guided to 71% with a back-loaded, unproven recovery path.
Tariffs described as 'a little bit of an unknown' with no quantification.
China data center sales remain at about half of pre-export-control levels and are expected to stay there absent regulatory change.
Growth decelerating from 114% to ~65% YoY on the law of large numbers.
Networking revenue declined 9% YoY during the product transition.
key_opportunities: Blackwell ramp is the fastest product ramp in company history, delivering $11B in its first full quarter.
Three scaling laws (pretraining, post-training, inference time) driving demand for AI computing.
Enterprise revenue grew nearly 2x year on year.
Automotive vertical revenue expected to grow to approximately $5 billion this fiscal year.
New products (Blackwell Ultra, Vera Rubin) on annual cadence.

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: Management expresses strong confidence in the Blackwell ramp and long-term AI demand ('Demand for Blackwell is extraordinary'), but also acknowledges significant forward uncertainties on margins ('we are focusing on expediting our manufacturing') and tariffs ('it's a little bit of an unknown').
